messages.content: good morning. i usually read with breakfast, but today i just want to look out of the window.
good morning. that sounds like a quiet choice for today. you can leave the book for another time if that is what you want.
my brother says that must mean i am giving up reading.
one morning without a book does not mean you are giving up reading. it can simply mean you want a different kind of morning.
i can see people walking to work, and it makes me happy i have a free day.
you can enjoy watching the morning outside without having to go to work yourself today.
yes. i am happy i can stay home. can you say that in one sentence?
you can enjoy being home and watching the morning outside.
what should i say if he asks why i am not reading?
i feel like looking out of the window today. i can read another time.
can i leave the last sentence out?
yes. you do not have to give a plan for later just to explain what you want now.
just give me that short answer.
i feel like looking out of the window today.
which is right: i was at home or i were at home?
i was at home is right for that simple sentence.
what about they?
they were at home.
now make it a question about me.
were you at home?
why did you not write was you?
for this question with you, use were. the answer about yourself can still be i was at home.
what about she?
was she at home? she was at home.
write examples with we and he, but no explanation.
we were at home. he was at home.
do those examples tell me they were all at the same house together?
no. the sentences give grammar examples, not enough information to know whether the people were in one house together.
give me that last answer in fewer words.
no. the examples do not say it was the same house or the same day.
what is the difference between my father works at the library and my father is a worker at the library?
the first says what he does. the other calls him a worker there. both can be true about the same person.
can you make a question from the first sentence?
does your father work at the library?
now give a short answer if the answer is yes.
yes, he works at the library.
can you make it about my mother instead?
yes, she works at the library.
what if i am not giving you a real fact, just a grammar task?
then these are examples. i should not keep them as facts about where your parents really work.
write the example with both parents.
my father and mother work at the library.
why did works change to work?
you are now talking about the two people together. in that sentence, use work.
now make one example with working.
my father is working at the library today.
i can have tea or coffee, but i want neither. does that mean i want both?
no. you do not want either of those choices.
say it with the name of each drink.
you do not want tea, and you do not want coffee.
what if i want water instead?
then you have chosen a different drink. you could say: i do not want tea or coffee. i would like water, please.
does that tell you i never like tea?
no. it only gives your choice in this conversation. you might like tea at another time.
write one sentence with neither and today.
neither of those drinks is what i want today.
now write it without neither.
i do not want tea or coffee today.
now use either in a question.
would either tea or coffee work for you?
my answer is water. give a short reply i can use to make that clear.
water, please. no tea or coffee today.
give me one example with am, one with is, and one with are.
i am here. she is here. they are here.
now make them about reading a book.
i am reading a book. she is reading a book. they are reading a book.
can you make the question for each one?
am i reading a book? is she reading a book? are they reading a book?
does they always mean people i have already given a name for?
not always. a conversation can use they for a group when it is clear who the group is, even without giving every name.
can you give a shorter answer?
you do not have to give a name for every person. you do need enough information to make clear which group you mean.
if i just start by saying they are here, do you know who?
not from that alone. i would ask who you mean.
ask me that question and nothing else.
who do you mean by they?
i mean the people from my story, but i have not told you the story yet.
then i still need to know which people you mean. can you tell me about them?
what does herself mean in she looked at herself in the mirror?
the person looking and the person she saw in the mirror were the same person.
say it with her own face.
she was looking at her own face in the mirror, not another person.
what if i say she looked at her in the mirror?
then her could be another woman. you would need more information to know who her is about.
write an example with himself.
he looked at himself in the mirror.
now make it about us talking as a group.
we looked at ourselves in the mirror.
what if i am alone?
you could say: i looked at myself in the mirror.
does myself have to mean i looked good?
no. it says that the person looking is the same person seen in the mirror. it does not say how you felt about what you saw.
give me a short answer.
no. it says who you looked at, not how you felt about yourself.
i asked my friend when she was coming, and she said i am happy to visit. is that an answer to the time question?
you know how she feels about the visit, but not when she will come. you could ask for the day or time again.
write a kind question i can ask next.
i am happy you are coming too. which day would work for you?
what if i already know the day but need morning or afternoon?
then ask about that part: will you come in the morning or afternoon?
why is that better than asking when again?
it makes clear which part you still need to know. she can answer about morning or afternoon without giving the day again.
give me a shorter explanation.
it asks for the part you still need to know: morning or afternoon.
she answers afternoon. now can i say she will come at two?
not unless she gives that time. afternoon does not give a specific hour.
give me one short sentence about what i know.
you know she plans to come in the afternoon, but not the hour.
write a story with a brush as an object and brush as something a person does.

a boy was getting ready to visit his grandmother. he found a brush on the shelf and asked his mother if he could use it. she said yes. he used it to brush his hair before putting it back. then he went to the door with his book. when his grandmother opened her door later, he told her he had got ready by himself and was happy to see her.
which brush was the object?
the brush he found on the shelf.
which part was something he did?
he used it to brush his hair.
can a word be the same in writing but do something different in each sentence?
yes. the other words help show how brush is being used.
say that with object and does.
yes. the other words in the sentence help show whether brush is an object or something he does.
did the story tell us what color it was?
no. it only said the brush was on the shelf.
write one question that would ask for that detail.
what color was the brush?
one book has a price of three coins, and another has a price of five coins. how much more is the book with the larger price?
the difference in price is two coins. five is two more than three.
now explain which book needs more coins.
the book with a price of five coins needs two more coins than the one with a price of three.
if i have five coins, can i buy both?
no. buying both would need eight coins. with five, you can buy the five coin book or the three coin book, but not both.
what if i buy the three coin book?
you would have two coins left.
is that enough to buy the five coin book too?
no. you would need three more coins to have five after buying the first book.
write a short answer about the choice i can make now.
you can choose either book with your five coins, but you cannot buy both.
what did i ask at first that was not the same as buying both?
you asked how much more one book was than the other. the difference in price is two coins, not the price of both together.
my brother is usually home after work. can i say he is probably there now?
you can use probably to show that you think it may be true because it often happens. you have not checked where he is right now.
give me the meaning of probably in one sentence.
probably can show that you think it may be true because it often happens, but you have not checked it now.
can you tell me he is home for sure?
no. what he usually does after work does not tell us for sure where he is at this moment.
give me the answer in fewer words.
no. knowing he is often home after work does not tell us for sure where he is now.
what question could i send him?
are you home now?
he says he is still at work. should i keep saying probably home?
no. you now have new information from him. from what he said, he is still at work.
does that make my first thought a lie?
not if you were clear that you were not sure. getting new information can change what you think.
keep it simple. what changed?
you were not sure before. now he has told you where he is.
write a story about someone visiting a town, but do not give the town a name.

a woman took a train to a town she had not seen before. she walked from the station to a small park and sat on a chair near a tree. she had brought a book, but spent some time looking at a house near the park instead of reading. later, she found a place to have lunch and wrote a short note about the visit. she did not need to see every street to remember one good afternoon. before going home, she took a picture of the tree by the park chair.
give me just the part about what she did instead of reading.
she had brought a book, but spent some time looking at a house near the park instead of reading.
can you tell me what town it was?
no. the story does not give a name for the town.
can a story be clear without giving every place a name?
yes. we can follow the visit through the station, park, and lunch without knowing the name of the town.
say it in fewer words.
yes. we can follow what she did without knowing the name of the town.
what did she take a picture of?
the tree by the park chair.
fix the grammar in i does not want to go, but do not change what i want.
i do not want to go.
now fix she do not want to go.
she does not want to go.
what word did you keep because it changes the meaning?
not. leaving it out would say the person wants to go instead.
if i ask for a more kind sentence, should you turn no into yes?
no. a kind way can keep the same choice. for example: thank you for asking, but i do not want to go.
what if i add today at the end?
then you are saying you do not want to go today. that leaves open whether you might want to go on another day.
give only the kind sentence without today.
thank you for asking, but i do not want to go.
why can fixing grammar and changing meaning be different things?
you can make the grammar right while keeping what the person wants the same.
say it with sentence and choice.
you can make the sentence right without changing the choice it gives.
is she walks to the library about now or about the past?
it could be about what she often does, or it could be a way of telling a story as if it is happening now. for the past, you would usually say she walked.
give me just the possible meaning of she walks to the library.
she walks to the library can be about what she often does, or about a story being told as if it is happening now.
what would be a clear past sentence?
she walked to the library yesterday.
now say she had finished before the visit began.
she had finished the walk before the visit began.
does that mean the visit happened first?
no. the walk was finished before the visit began.
write one story line where two people are doing something at the same time.
she was reading while her sister was drawing.
ask a question about what her sister was doing.
what was her sister doing while she was reading?
drawing.
yes. her sister was drawing while she read.
my plan was to read in the kitchen after breakfast, but my mother needs the table. i can read in the living room instead.
then the place changes, while the reading and the time after breakfast can stay the same.
do i need to give up the whole morning?
not from that change alone. if the living room works for reading, you can keep the goal and use the new place.
what if i also want to talk with my mother while she works?
then reading quietly in another room may not give you that part of what you wanted. you could choose whether talking or reading is more important for that time.
give me one question to ask myself.
what do i want more right now: quiet reading or time talking with my mother?
can i do one and then the other?
yes, if there is time and your mother is happy to talk. you could talk for a while, then read in the living room.
why did your first answer only talk about reading?
you had not yet told me you wanted the time with your mother as well as the reading.
say it another way.
that wish was new information you gave later.
tell a story with a book and a photo inside it. later, the photo should move but the book should stay.

a woman was reading an old book when she found a photo between the pages. she took the photo out and put it on the kitchen table. the book stayed on her chair. after lunch, her brother came to visit. she showed him the photo and asked whether he remembered the people in it. he took it to the window to see it better. they talked there for a while, then he put the photo on the shelf. the book was still on the chair where she had left it.
where is the photo at the end?
on the shelf.
where is the book?
on the chair.
did the photo stay inside the book because that was where she first found it?
no. she took it out, and it moved to the table, the window, and then the shelf. the book did not move with it.
what if someone asks where they can find the picture now?
in this story, picture can mean the photo. they should look on the shelf.
does that mean every picture in the room is on the shelf?
no. the story only gives the place of this one photo. it does not give a place for every possible picture.
give me just the known place.
the photo is on the shelf.
two friends asked me to visit on the same afternoon. i can only go to one. i do not want the other to think i care less about them.
you can explain the time problem without saying one friend is better than the other. you cannot make two visits at once.
write a kind message asking whether another day is possible.
i would like to see you. would another day work for you as well?
should i say i already have another plan if i have not chosen which visit yet?
no. if you have not chosen, do not say you already have a plan. you can explain that you are trying to choose a time.
write that message.
i am trying to choose a time to visit. would another day work for you as well?
should i tell them one friend is better?
not if the problem is time. that would change a question about the day into a question about which friend you like more.
give a simple answer.
you can say the afternoon does not work without saying one person is better.
end with one short message.
i would like to see you. can we choose another day?
my teacher asked what part of a story i liked best. my friend chose the last page, and i chose the first. which answer is wrong?
neither has to be wrong. a question about what each of you liked can have different answers for different people.
what if the question was where did the boy leave his book?
then the story gives facts to check. what you liked is not the same as where an object was in the story.
say it simply.
what you liked is about your choice. where the book was is about a fact the story gives.
if the story says the book was on the shelf, can i answer on the table because i like that place better?
no. what you like does not change the place of the book in the story.
give me just the answer to the place question.
on the shelf.
why was it okay for us to choose different pages for the first question?
because that question was about what each of you liked, not which place was given as a fact.
i told you a small animal is by the tree and a large animal is by the door. if i later say animal, do you know which one i mean?
not always. both are animals. the word alone does not tell me whether you mean the small one or the large one.
what could i add without giving each animal a name?
you could say the small animal or the animal by the door. those details help choose between the two.
now i say the large one moved to the garden. where is the small one?
you have not said it moved. from the facts you gave, it is still by the tree.
can i use the animal by the door to mean the large one after it moves?
you can, but it may be more clear to say the animal that was by the door. that keeps the old place apart from the new one.
give me the best sentence about the move.
the large animal that was by the door is now in the garden.
why is was useful?
it makes the door its old place, rather than saying it is still there.
my first message says i will visit after lunch. the new message says i may visit after lunch. what changed?
the new message makes the visit less sure. after lunch is still there, but will has changed to may.
keep the answer simple.
the time is still after lunch. the visit is now a possible plan rather than a sure plan.
what did not change?
the part of the day: after lunch.
can you say i have chosen not to come?
no. may does not mean you have chosen not to come. it leaves the choice open.
give me a simple last answer.
you have not said yes for sure, but you have not said no either.
now i add i have chosen to come. what could the message say?
i will visit after lunch.
does that give a specific hour?
no. after lunch does not by itself give an hour from a clock.
what could someone ask if they need that detail?
what time after lunch will you come?
i have to leave, but talking helped me think. say goodbye without giving me another task.
it is good that the talk helped. goodbye, and i hope your day goes well.
can you make it shorter?
goodbye. i hope your day goes well.
now make it warm without saying you will miss me.
goodbye. it was good to talk with you.
does that mean you have feelings like a person?
i can use a warm way of talking, but i do not have feelings like a person. i can still give you a kind reply.
just give the short goodbye again.
goodbye. i hope your day goes well.
thank you. no more questions.
you are welcome. goodbye.
